Cryptocurrency gains are taxed at 30% with 1% TDS; the 2021 bill seeking to ban private cryptocurrency remains pending.
Cryptocurrency is legal tender issued by the RBI and is exempt from tax.
Cryptocurrency gains are taxed at 30% with 1% TDS, and losses may always be freely set off against all income.
x: Crypto gains attract a 30% tax and 1% TDS. The 2021 bill proposing a ban on private crypto remains pending; cryptocurrency is not RBI-issued legal tender.
